scorecard.success_clause_status: DEFECT: scorecard v1.10 contains no M11 paragraph labelled Success.
scorecard.operative_comparative_bar_verbatim:
The fastest-mode tie is product ID then mode ID. Strehl must have `R_c>=2.00` for each
of `C33`, `C105`, and `C299`, and `R_pool>=2.00`. The per-capture envelope is
intentional: no slow capture or favourable global mode can hide a miss.

current_adjudication.comparative_reason: M1 is withdrawn with no admissible bar, so no mode can satisfy M11's fastest-quality-qualified-comparator predicate; required commercial Zerene modes are also unavailable under a valid licence
current_adjudication.product_native_reason: the current scorecard defines separate product-native disclosures, but their absolute wall times cannot be admitted under the observed uncontrolled host load
current_adjudication.absolute_timing_release_condition: reproduce with recorded preflight and in-run load inside the frozen scorecard gates on a genuinely quiet host

commercial_comparator_execution.reason: Zerene's installed trial is consumed and expired and Helicon is not installed; commercial execution requires a future owner-authorized contract revision after a valid licence exists

comparative.input: byte-identical uncompressed 16-bit linear ProPhoto RGB D50 TIFFs on one volume
comparative.optional_absence_rule: each unavailable Helicon mode must be explicitly recorded with a non-empty reason; available optional modes enter the full quality envelope
comparative.quantity: for each capture c, T_c=min_m(minimum comparator-mode wall), S_c=minimum 16-worker strehl wall, R_c=T_c/S_c; require every R_c>=2.00 and R_pool=sum_c(T_c)/sum_c(S_c)>=2.00, with product-ID then mode-ID ties; common-merge canonical output must also be byte-identical across workers 1/2/4/8/16
comparative.allowed_difference: program and frozen mode settings only; among strehl worker-ladder settings only the operational worker selection may differ

product.input: byte-identical staged copies of the original ARWs
product.publication_role: reported in full but cannot satisfy, rescue, fail, or otherwise alter the common-merge M11 publication verdict

timing_boundary.start: QPC immediately before suspended root-process creation
timing_boundary.stop: after Job Object process count reaches zero, TIFF exclusive-open flush/validation/hash, and invocation-manifest close/flush/hash
includes: invocation manifest write, flush, close, and hash
timing_boundary.representation: integer QueryPerformanceCounter ticks plus integer QueryPerformanceFrequency; subtract ticks before binary64 conversion
timing_boundary.process_identity: preverify and lock the frozen executable bundle before QPC start; retain each root/descendant canonical image path and its matching preverified SHA-256 without rereading executable contents inside the boundary; reject every image outside the bundle

stage_evidence.comparator_rule: vendor stages may be unavailable with an explicit source/reason; native-RAW comparator timing then remains diagnostic and the common-TIFF arm remains competitive

schedule.order: forward on odd sweeps, exact reverse on even sweeps
schedule.headline: minimum per setting
schedule.rejection: abort and invalidate the campaign if any member fails a condition gate; never keep half of a paired sweep

quality_qualification.source: scorecard named sections 0.2 Joint anti-cheat constraints, 1.3 Output transfer and the tone sentinel, M4 retained component, and M11 Comparative statistic, qualification, and ties
quality_qualification.rule: require the Strehl 16-worker denominator, licensed Zerene PMax, licensed Zerene DMap, and the fresh best-known-source fork rebuild to qualify; record Helicon A/B/C availability and include every obtainable mode; one binary/settings fingerprint per timed mode must pass the common-input transfer/geometry contract, M1, M2, M3, M8, and the retained M4 250-tile flat-power-plus-transfer component on frozen quality-corpus outputs, and every timed output must independently pass its applicable controls

conditions.host_reservation_policy: no lane lock is admissibility evidence; accept only recorded preflight and in-run condition gates
conditions.hardware_probe_protocol: one persistent hash-bound process emitting one flushed JSON object per 10 ms sample
conditions.gpu_process_allowlist: predeclared OS display processes plus PIDs in the timed Job Object; any other GPU-using process invalidates the campaign
conditions.input_stability: each invocation receives an owned private hard-link snapshot of exactly its timed prefix; all snapshot files are opened read-only without write/delete sharing from the preflight content hash through process-tree drain and the matching postflight content hash
conditions.execution_stability: all existing-file argv entries are resolved against the actual execution cwd to canonical physical paths; every executable, script, support file, host probe, and generated live-replay specification is held open without write/delete sharing and hash-checked around use; cold preflight hashes use Windows FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING
conditions.record_integrity: a separately flushed content-addressed measurement receipt binds the complete run record, including the post-drain endpoint, wall time, telemetry, input checks, and condition checks
conditions.warm_cache: one warm-up; shared OS/page cache warm; fresh private output, temp, application cache, and warp-map directories per invocation
conditions.cold_cache: six predeclared actual-reboot cold/warm pairs per N and candidate CPU-16/hybrid setting; each pair has a unique current Windows BootId receipt, cold precedes its warm mate, and equivalent resets are rejected
conditions.cold_input_preflight: all timed-input and timed-executable-bundle content hashing after reboot and before the cold member uses Windows FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING; common-TIFF structural/pixel witnesses are reused only after the exact TIFF byte hash matches their frozen manifest
conditions.campaign_attempt_ledger: a campaign-hash-keyed append-only ledger freezes one records path, chains before/after record-file hashes, and permanently invalidates any aborted or incomplete invocation attempt

commissioning.development_null: identical arms; paired 95% interval must cover 0 seconds
commissioning.comparative_ratio_controls: the same synthetic timer path must make every capture and pooled ratio pass above 2.00 with Strehl faster and fail below 2.00 with Strehl slower

live_replay.status: UNBOUND - signed trace and commissioned signature verifier required
live_replay.definition: fresh owned spool; stacker starts first; a signed acquisition trace supplies monotonic shutter-close and durable file-availability offsets; exclusive per-file read locks prohibit stacker access until each hash-verified source is atomically hard-linked into the spool and released at availability; the scored epoch is shutter close of frame 100 and the maximum of all six scored latencies must be <=10.0 seconds

m12_bridge.rule: M11 PASS requires the canonical common-merge strehl output (frozen here as scored repetition 1) to be mutually byte-identical across workers 1/2/4/8/16 at N=33/105/299 and the common-merge worker-16 timing to pass the >=2.00x bar; within-worker six-repeat determinism is an M12 disclosure and does not gate M11. M12 may consume only settings and output/pixel hashes that match the exact M11 common-merge worker-16 cells and only when the M11 publication verdict is PASS
